description: This file defines the UtilityReceiver class, a WakefulBroadcastReceiver that handles geofence trigger events by forwarding intents to UtilityService, ensuring the device remains awake during processing.

classes.name: UtilityReceiver
classes.description: A WakefulBroadcastReceiver that handles geofence trigger events and delegates processing to UtilityService.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the incoming broadcast, sets up the intent with the UtilityService class and action, and starts the wakeful service to process the geofence event.
